title: Repeat the move for staging, then production
description: After development is cut over and stable: bootstrap-and-role (already done per account by the first card), then the environment deploy, verification and cutover for chatticus-staging and chatticus-production, in that order. Production also needs a data and Cognito user plan (users cannot be exported with passwords; Google federation re-links by email). Do not start until development has run in its new account for a while.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Staging and production accounts now have ChatticusBudgets (25 and 100 USD per month, placeholder amounts for Ryan to confirm via 02713a), ChatticusSnapshots, ChatticusComputers and the thin-turn stack, deployed with the guarded dedicated-account script. Environment variables for the budget limit are set on the staging and production GitHub environments. Not done: zones, certificates, auth, web (blocked on the hostname decision, because legacy still owns staging.chattic.us and hey.chattic.us), secrets, and GitHub cutover. Ryan must confirm the new SNS email subscriptions.

right_now_summary: Staging and production infrastructure is deployed; hostname decisions block the remaining setup and cutover.
